deficiencies.description: The rewrite states that the stained slice illustrates the explanting of a tumour, which the text does not state.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Here you're looking at a slice through a tumor and a stain to look at the morphology.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: A slice through a tumour, with a stain to show the morphology, illustrates this

considerations.sourcePassage: So the other thing to appreciate is that when, if you like, biologists are studying tumors
considerations.reason: Dropping conversational filler ('if you like', 'So the other thing to appreciate is that') is an allowed change.

considerations.sourcePassage: But cancer biologists will also, for example, disaggregate a tumor like this
considerations.reason: Omitting 'for example' does not alter the scientific meaning of the passage.

considerations.sourcePassage: So when HeLa cells, which were the first tumor cells to grow in culture, did that, this was very much a surprise.
considerations.reason: Rephrasing to remove 'did that' is an allowed stylistic change since the rewrite retains the fact that they were the first to grow in culture and that it was a surprise.

considerations.sourcePassage: contributions of things like the stroma and other things.
considerations.reason: Replacing 'other things' with 'other components' is an allowed change as it clarifies the meaning with a more precise word that does not change the scientific claim.

considerations.sourcePassage: Whoops, I forgot to start my clock. Okay.
considerations.reason: Dropping a remark to the audience is an allowed change.
